market_insights: Leading paid themes ship one codebase with several presets; presets change look, not features (Symmetry docs).
Horizon raised the bar on editor flexibility: nested theme blocks and group blocks. VSN must match this with theme blocks.
Since 2025 Theme Store rules forbid Dawn/Horizon-derived code and require real uniqueness, so VSN starts from Skeleton.
Opportunity: speed, built-in conversion features that are Theme Store compliant, large-catalog (super mart) UX, RTL.
Cross-platform evidence must retain source type: official feature listing is not an interactive demo audit; WooCommerce/Magento functionality is not necessarily portable to Shopify.

Oct 19 Koala tracked-store chart puts Dawn/Trademark joint-leading by rounded count; do not treat older rank_koala_2026 as current. Large catalogs: prioritize Warehouse/Empire; DTC narration: Impact/Porto Single Product; food trust: Local/Porto Grocery.
